dialogue.origin: チェミーさん、こんばんは。本日は宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Good evening, Chemy. Thank you for coming today.

dialogue.origin: すみません…大変遅くなりました
dialogue.content: I'm sorry… I'm terribly late.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ、大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.content: No worries at all. Are you all right?

dialogue.origin: 今からでも大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is it still okay to start now?

dialogue.origin: お願いします。
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: はい、それでは始めさせていただきます。宜しくお願いします。
dialogue.content: All right, then I will begin. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、相談員です。ご相談にあたり、年齢と性別を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm the counselor. Before we begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: はい。30歳女性です
dialogue.content: Yes. I'm a 30-year-old woman.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。今日はどんなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: はい。上司に嫌がらせを受けています
dialogue.content: Yes. I'm being harassed by my boss.

dialogue.origin: それはお仕事にいくのが憂鬱になってしまいますね。
dialogue.content: That must make you dread going to work.

dialogue.origin: もう少し詳しく教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me a bit more about it?

dialogue.origin: えぇ。男性上司なのですが、
dialogue.content: Yes. It's a male supervisor, and...

dialogue.origin: 休みの日は何してるの？から始まり
dialogue.content: It started with him asking things like, "What do you do on your days off?"

dialogue.origin: ええ…
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 一緒にご飯行こうとか、それはまだいいんですけど、
dialogue.content: He'd ask me to go out for a meal, and things like that—which I could still brush off, but...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 奥さんがいらっしゃるのに、2人で遊びに行こうと言われて
dialogue.content: Even though he has a wife, he asked me to go out with him, just the two of us.

dialogue.origin: え〜っ！！
dialogue.content: Oh, really?!

dialogue.origin: 奥さんがいらっしゃるじゃないですか！と断っても、最近うまくいってないとか言われていて…
dialogue.content: Even when I refuse, saying, "But you have a wife!" he says things like, "Things haven't been going well with her lately..."

dialogue.origin: それは困りますね。
dialogue.content: That's very troubling.

dialogue.origin: はい…困っています
dialogue.content: Yes… I'm troubled.

dialogue.origin: 既婚男性である上司から食事やら、２人で出かけることやら誘われて断って聞き入れてもらえない……それは迷惑ですよね。上司でもあるので、むげにもできないですよね。
dialogue.content: So your married male boss keeps asking you out for meals or to go out together, and he won't take no for an answer... That must be very troubling. And since he's your boss, you can't just bluntly refuse him, can you?

dialogue.origin: 社員の人数が少ないので、うまくやっていきたいのですが…かなり会社に行くのが憂鬱です
dialogue.content: Since there aren't many employees, I want to get along with everyone, but... it's making me really dread going to work.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、なおさらやりにくさがあるのですね。毎日のことですし、それは参ってしまいますね。
dialogue.content: I see, that makes it even more difficult, doesn't it? It's something you face every day, so it must be really draining.

dialogue.origin: それは、もうどれくらい続いているのですか？
dialogue.content: How long has this been going on?

dialogue.origin: 3カ月くらいでしょうか…
dialogue.content: About three months, I think…

dialogue.origin: 長く感じます…
dialogue.content: It feels like a long time...

dialogue.origin: それは長いですよ。よく耐えていらっしゃいましたね。周囲の人は気づいている風でしょうか？
dialogue.content: That is a long time. You've been enduring it so well. Do you think the people around you have noticed?

dialogue.origin: 周りは男性社員なのですが、なんとなく気付いているような気がします。部長のお気に入りだよね！とか言われます
dialogue.content: The other employees are all men, but I feel like they've kind of noticed. They say things like, "You're the department head's favorite!"

dialogue.origin: そうなんですか。そう言われてどんな風に感じますか？
dialogue.content: I see. How do you feel when they say that?

dialogue.origin: とんでもないよ！と、ぶっとばしてやりたいですよ
dialogue.content: I feel like yelling, "No way!" and I want to punch them.

dialogue.origin: それは、上司を？それとも茶化した男性を？
dialogue.content: Do you mean your boss? Or the men who are teasing you?

dialogue.origin: どちらもです！
dialogue.content: Both of them!

dialogue.origin: ええ、そうですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, I can understand that.

dialogue.origin: ところで、部長ということは直属の上司は間に居るということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: By the way, since he's a department head, does that mean you have a direct supervisor between you and him?

dialogue.origin: いいえ、社員がたった4人しかいないので、社長、部長、男性の同僚、私だけです。
dialogue.content: No, there are only four employees in total: the president, the department head, a male colleague, and me.

dialogue.origin: そうですか。それは、本当にどうしたものかと困ってしまいますね。部長から執拗な誘いを受けていて、周囲の男性社員も知っているけれども、4人しかいない会社でうまくやっていきたいけどどうしたらよいか…ということですね。
dialogue.content: I see. That really is a difficult situation with no easy answer. So you're receiving persistent invitations from the department head, your male colleagues are aware of it, but you want to maintain a good working relationship in a company with only four people, and you don't know what to do... is that correct?

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 辞めたいです
dialogue.content: I want to quit.

dialogue.origin: そうですか……。その件で辞めたいとまで思われているのですね。確かに、辞めたくもなりますよね。お仕事内容や、待遇など、部長のことを抜きにしたら今の職場はいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see... It's gotten to the point where you want to quit because of this. I can certainly understand why you'd feel that way. Putting the issue with the department head aside, how do you feel about your current workplace in terms of job content and benefits?

dialogue.origin: 仕事は事務なので、まぁいたって普通というか、待遇もすごく良い訳ではないけれど、悪くないので、辞めていないのです
dialogue.content: My job is office work, so it's pretty standard. The benefits aren't great, but they're not bad either, which is why I haven't quit yet.

dialogue.origin: それでは、さほど執着もない感じですね。
dialogue.content: So it sounds like you're not particularly attached to the job itself.

dialogue.origin: では、辞めるとなって、何か他にお困りになることは？
dialogue.content: So, if you were to quit, are there any other concerns you would have?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。今、転職して、すぐ仕事が見つかるかなぁと。一人暮らしで、家賃を払わないといけないので。貯金がほとんどないのです
dialogue.content: Well, I'm worried about whether I'd be able to find a new job right away if I change jobs now. I live alone and have to pay rent, and I have almost no savings.

dialogue.origin: 一応正社員だったので
dialogue.content: I was a full-time employee, so...

dialogue.origin: ボーナスもあります
dialogue.content: I also get bonuses.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、、、次も同程度の待遇で転職できるかが心配なのですね。一人暮らしだとシビアですよね。
dialogue.content: I see... so you're worried about whether you can find another job with similar benefits. It's tough when you live alone, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: ただ、そのことと、部長の下で働き続けることを天秤にかけたら、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: However, if you were to weigh that against continuing to work under your department head, how would you feel?

dialogue.origin: うーん。やっぱり耐えられないです。味方がいないというか、昔の企業体質なので
dialogue.content: Hmm. I really can't tolerate it. It's like I have no allies, and the company has an old-fashioned corporate culture.

dialogue.origin: 無理に耐える必要もないと思います。それと、もう一つ、昔の企業体質とうことでは、社長に相談したところで難しそうですよね。
dialogue.content: I don't think you need to force yourself to endure it. Also, given what you said about the old-fashioned corporate culture, it seems like talking to the president wouldn't be very helpful, would it?

dialogue.origin: えぇ。社長は、我、関せずというタイプなので
dialogue.content: Yes. The president is the type who doesn't get involved.

dialogue.origin: お話をお聞きしていて、感じたこととして…
dialogue.content: As I've been listening to you, what I'm sensing is...

dialogue.origin: 社長は確かに、確かに。
dialogue.content: The president, yes, I see.

dialogue.origin: 今の会社では耐えられない、でも次もそこそこのお給料がないと厳しい。次を決めないでの退職はリスクがあるので、転職エージェントなどを使いながら転職活動をされてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You can't endure it at your current company, but it would be difficult without a decent salary at your next job. Quitting without having a new job lined up is risky, so how about you start looking for a new job using a recruitment agency while you're still working?

dialogue.origin: なるほど…働きながら探すのがいい方法ですね
dialogue.content: I see... looking for a job while I'm still working is a good idea.

dialogue.origin: 体力や時間のやりくりは負担がかかると思いますが、精神的には安定して出来るかなというのと、焦って変な求人にとびつきにくいかと…。
dialogue.content: It might be demanding in terms of energy and time management, but I think you'd be more mentally stable, and you'd be less likely to jump at a bad job offer out of desperation.

dialogue.origin: 確かに、精神的な余裕は大事ですね！
dialogue.content: That's true, having that peace of mind is important!

dialogue.origin: 転職サイトにまずは登録してみます
dialogue.content: I'll start by registering on a job search website.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。まずは、動いてみてください。ずっとこの会社かと思うと、ますます部長からの嫌がらせも憂鬱になってしまいますしね。
dialogue.content: Yes. Please take that first step. If you feel stuck in this company forever, the manager's harassment will feel even more depressing.

dialogue.origin: はい！ずっと1人で悩んで、憂鬱でしたが、少し光が見えてきました
dialogue.content: Yes! I've been worrying about this all by myself and feeling so down, but now I can see a little bit of light.

dialogue.origin: 今まで、八方ふさがりだったのですね。その光がもっともっと強い光となっていくと良いですね。本日はこのあたりでご相談を終了してもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: It sounds like you felt completely trapped until now. I hope that light becomes brighter and brighter for you. Would it be all right to conclude our session for today?

dialogue.origin: はい！ありがとうございました！前向きに動けそうです！
dialogue.content: Yes! Thank you so much! I feel like I can move forward now!

dialogue.origin: 本日はご相談有難うございました。また何かありましたらいつでもご相談にいらしてください。それでは、失礼いたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for talking with me today. Please feel free to come back anytime if anything else comes up. Goodbye for now.

dialogue.origin: はい！ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes! Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 本日は、相談者役有難うございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for playing the role of the client today.

dialogue.origin: 遅れてすみませんでした(moon troubled)
dialogue.content: I'm sorry for being late. (moon troubled)

dialogue.origin: いえいえ、大丈夫です。お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.content: Not at all, it's fine. Thank you for your time.

dialogue.origin: お疲れ様でした(happy)
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. (happy)

dialogue.origin: しかも、遅い時間に。。。それでは、ロープレも終了いたします。
dialogue.content: And at such a late hour, too... Well then, we will now conclude the role-play session.

topic.sub: 上司からの嫌がらせ問題
